notes.title: Version 3.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Version 3.2 is available now, which includes some general balance changes and bug fixes. These changes are meant to counter the increase in difficulty caused by some of the new elements introduced in Version 3.0. 




[hr][/hr]Patch Notes


Changes to Enemies: 

Seeker (All Stages)

HP Reduced by 10

Melee damage boost against Seekers increased from 2.25x to 2.5x

Starting wave increased from 8 to 11

Move speed reduced and made more consistent

Initial charge time increased from 0.3s to 0.8s

Charger (Stage 3)

Damage reduced from 50 to 40

Defense Pierce increased from 0% to 10%

Charger (Stage 4)

Defense Pierce reduced from 100% to 35%



Changes to Upgrades:

 Excess Charge

Lightning chains triggered by charged enemies can no longer inflict charged status to other enemies.

Defense Up

Removed

(We're planning on reworking this upgrade in the next major update. For now, we have disabled it due to conflicts with changes to the Resistance perk in this patch.)



Changes to Perks:

Resistance

Tier 1 defense increased from 5% to 15%

Tier 2 defense increased from 15% to 30%

Tier 3 defense increased from 30% to 50%

Tier 4 defense increased from 50% to 70%

Vitality

Tier 1 HP increased from +10HP to +15HP

Tier 2 HP increased from +25HP to +30HP



General Bug Fixes


Fixed a bug where taking the Desperation upgrade while on low HP would cause the player to be debuffed after healing.

Other smaller fixes.

notes.title: Version 3.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We're pushing Version 3.1 out to fix some small bugs that popped up after we released Version 3.0.

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes
General Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that made Assassinate not count as melee damage toward the Tempest's shield.
Fixed a bug with Assassinate that sometimes allowed the player to pass through walls.
Other smaller fixes.

notes.title: -Version 3.0- ANOMALY💥Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It's been a while, but we have been hard at work on exciting new features and content. Today, we're introducing Version 3.0 ANOMALY💥!

Check out the update trailer here:
[previewyoutube=ZEk8MTgGXwI;full][/previewyoutube]
This is an exciting one! We're introducing 2 brand new features: Anomaly waves and Last Chance upgrades, 2 new classes, a new ability, and a brand new enemy.

With these new features, we aimed to enhance the decision making process while picking upgrades by adding some exciting new stakes, as well as add some interesting new effects to play with. Anomaly waves can make anything happen...!

We also introduced a new enemy: the Seeker! 👁️
This high-speed enemy explodes into clouds of dangerous gas, that can harm you and other enemies!

And we've also added two brand new classes: the Assassin, and the Heavy Gunner!
Unlike existing classes, these new classes have different firing modes: a burst fire, and a charge fire!

Some new achievements, and many other smaller changes and quality-of-life improvements are packed in as well. We hope everyone has fun with the new content! Take a look at the proper patch notes below.

Until next time!
-Digital Firewood

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes

New Features:
Anomaly Waves
Last Chance Upgrades
"Go To Upgrade Machine" Button
 9 new achievements

New Classes:
Heavy Gunner
Assassin

New Enemy: Seeker

New Ability: Assassinate

Balance Changes

Changes to Enemies:
Charger
Reduced damage dealt.
Changes to Abilities:
Bullet Time
Increased effect time.
Changes to Classes:
Brute
Now starts with the Clash Parry upgrade.
General Changes:
Chain Lightning
Decreased damage dealt.
Upgrade Surge
Increased cost scaling.
First-Time User Experience
Adjusted the first run pre-determined upgrades.
Other
Adjusted drop rates of some upgrades.
Adjusted hit-stop effect for certain damage sources.
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that caused some achievements not to properly trigger.
Fixed a bug that caused scrolling UI elements to not sroll properly with a controller.
Other various bug fixes

notes.title: Version 2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We hope everyone had a good holiday. We're releasing a small patch to fix some issues that popped up since our 2.0 update released. 

We're also currently working on the next major update! Thank you very much to everyone who's played so far. 

Until next time!
-Digital Firewood

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes

Changes to Enemies:

Chaser
Stage 2 damage dealt reduced from 25HP to 20HP.
Stage 3 damage dealt reduced from 30HP to 25HP.
Stage 4 damage dealt reduced from 40HP to 30HP.
Spitter
Will no longer initiate fire at the player from off-screen.
Changes to Classes:
Rifleman
Increased base reload speed to 2.5s from 3s.
Light Gunner
Increased base reload speed to 2.2s from 2.3s.
Changes to Perks:
Luck Boost
Changed the function to make it more likely to see common upgrades occasionally.
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that caused UI to display incorrectly on ultrawide displays.
Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: -Version 2.0- SNOWSTORM❄️Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!! It's been over a month since launch and we've loved every moment watching everyone explore Breach the Abyss. Just in time for winter, we're launching our first major update- Version 2.0 SNOWSTORM!❄️ Check out our update trailer here:

[previewyoutube=EnnhYoNQQ9k;full][/previewyoutube]

This update is cold as ice. We've added some electrifying new upgrades, a new class, a new ability, and some cool new decorations, so now is a perfect time to jump back into the Abyss. 

With this update, we aimed to flesh out the ❄️Freeze upgrade set with brand-new options that increase its depth and transforms it into an exciting tactical playstyle. We've also introduced a brand-new set:⚡Lightning. This set focuses on long-range damage chains to help wipe out hordes of Abyssians with no sweat.

Outside of those, we have introduced a batch of standard upgrades, as well as the Hailstorm ability, and the Grenadier class. 

We hope everyone has fun exploring this update! Once again, thank you to everyone who has played the game so far- it means the world to us. 

Until next time!
- Digital Firewood

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes

New Ability: Hailstorm

New Class: Grenadier

New Map Variant (Limited Time): Abyss (Snow)

15 New Upgrades:
Explosive Ice
Tempered Ice
Chilling Ice
Chilling Shards
Lightning Rounds
Voltaic Counter
Lightning Amp
Current Up
Excess Charge
Clash Parry
Energetic Parry
Glass Cannon
Opportunist
Critical Eye
Power Clash

Balance Changes

Changes to Perks:
Power
Increased max level from 4 to 5.
Upgrade Surge
 Increased max level from 1 to 2.
Changes to existing upgrades:
Blizzard Parry
 Added a chance to freeze enemies upon parry.
Electrostatic Touch
 Will now start a lightning chain upon activation.

notes.title: Version 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Breach the Abyss Patch 1.3 is now released! This patch targets some bugs that slipped by our testing, as well as some quality-of-life changes for certain upgrades and abilities.

Full patch notes:

- Adjusted wave length to deliver a more consistent experience across all runs.

- Added additional functionality to the Auto-Turret ability which lets it ignore enemies it cannot retain line of sight on.

- Added additional functionality to the Auto-Turret ability which prevents it from being placed in invalid locations.

- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused [spoiler]The Tempest[/spoiler] to behave abnormally.

- Various other bug fixes.

Thanks for playing Breach the Abyss! We hope everyone has had lots of fun. There will be more to come, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Breach the Abyss takes home awards at Level Up Showcase 2024!
notes.content:
We took home awards!

Hey Everyone! Thanks to everyone who's checked out the game so far. 

We recently attended Level Up Showcase 2024, A showcase event for new developers all across Ontario. 

Out of 150+ Games at the event, we placed 2nd for Best Overall Game and 3rd for Best Artistic Achievement.

The team is super honoured to recieve these awards. Thanks to everyone who stopped by the event and played the game!

Rest assured this is not the end of the road, far from it. We're preparing for the full release of the game later this year, so please look forward to it!

Thank you!!!
